recognize_zh: 高倍下一大團立體、細胞彼此重疊擠壓的小圓藍細胞團，核質比高、核互相擠壓變形（nuclear molding），細胞質少且邊緣毛躁；骨髓抹片中這種緊密三維腫瘤細胞團是轉移性小圓藍細胞瘤（本例為神經母細胞瘤）的線索。
features: Large, thick three-dimensional cohesive cluster of overlapping tumor cells
Small-to-intermediate cells with high N:C ratio and nuclear molding
Dark nuclei with fine chromatin; nucleoli not resolvable due to cluster thickness
Scant, frayed pale-blue cytoplasm with faint fibrillary material at the cluster periphery
Admixed granulated myeloid precursors at the edges; background grey-tinted red cells in a camera photograph
describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a large, thick, cohesive cluster of overlapping small-to-intermediate tumor cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, nuclear molding and scant frayed cytoplasm. Cellular detail in the centre of the cluster is limited by thickness and focus, and a few granulated myeloid precursors are admixed at the periphery. Tight three-dimensional clusters with molding are characteristic of metastatic non-hematopoietic tumors rather than leukemia. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Blasts may pile up in thick areas but do not show nuclear molding or cohesive borders and are CD45/TdT or MPO-positive.
Rhabdomyosarcoma clusters show more cytoplasmic vacuolation and occasional multinucleated cells and are desmin/myogenin-positive.
Ewing sarcoma cells are CD99/NKX2.2-positive with EWSR1 fusion and lack neuropil.
Carcinoma clusters have more cytoplasm and keratin positivity, and medulloblastoma marrow spread is rare and clinically distinct.
